Detailed Definition: Defined recursively. Set xsga to 0 if missing.  Initialize with OrgCap = 4*general expenses (xsga) in the first year, and calculate as .85*OrgCap previous year + xsga/gnpdeflator current year thereafter. Scale by total assets (at).  Keep only december year ends, and non-financials, and non-missing sic code.  Then winsoriz at the 1% level and standardized by subtracting the same month within-industry mean (Fama French 17 industries) and dividing by the same month within industry standard deviation of OrgCap.
OrgCapAdj without the industry adjustment (see OrgCapAdj).
